video_title: 2026 Training Camp Media Availability | Coach J.B. Bickerstaff l 10.01.26

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: J.B. Bickerstaff on maintaining team chemistry during Cade Cunningham's absence
quotes.excerpt: When Cade Cunningham comes back, he'll be welcomed with open arms, his teammates will do the same.
quotes.quote: Obviously it's difficult. The most difficult part of our job is the business of basketball. It's a part of it. You get both sides of what's going on and how you handle it. What we try to do is build ourselves for the tough times. Our relationships aren't fleeting. When Cade Cunningham comes back, he'll be welcomed with open arms, his teammates will do the same, and it'll be who he is. That's the easy part for us because we have real relationships. If you don't, these things can get dicey, but if you have genuine relationships, you'll be able to work it out.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff says the Pistons are focused on building genuine relationships to handle the business side of basketball. He expects Cade Cunningham to be welcomed back with open arms once he returns to the team.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff on the timeline for Cade Cunningham's return to the court
quotes.excerpt: We got plenty of time before opening night. We'll do what's right by him always.
quotes.quote: We got plenty of time before opening night. I think we'll do what's right by him always, obviously. If there's time that's needed for a ramp-up, we'll give him that time for a ramp-up. We'll see what he looks like when he gets here, but knowing Cade Cunningham, he's working his tail off no matter where he is, so that when he gets here, he'll be prepared for what we need him to do.
quotes.social_post: Coach Bickerstaff says the Pistons will prioritize doing what is right for Cade Cunningham regarding his return timeline. He expects Cunningham to be fully prepared for opening night regardless of his current ramp up status.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff expects increased minutes for Ausar Thompson this season
quotes.excerpt: I definitely see his minutes going above 26.
quotes.quote: That's the expectation. Because we ask him to do so much, how we manage those minutes might look different. Does he run off 10-minute stretches? Maybe. But is he a six-minute here, six-minute there, whatever it may be? I definitely see his minutes going above 26.
quotes.social_post: Ausar Thompson is in line for a bigger role this season. J.B. Bickerstaff says he definitely sees Thompson playing more than 26 minutes per game as the team continues to ask him to do more on the floor.

quotes.speaker: J.B. Bickerstaff
quotes.summary_phrase: Bickerstaff on the impact of J.D. Dubois's development work
quotes.excerpt: He was a huge part of our development package.
quotes.quote: Two years of being with them every day and watching how he worked and the respect that he garnered throughout the entire organization. He was a huge part of our development package and you see a lot of our young guys that have continued to develop and get better. That's what the G is for. It's there for players to go develop, get better, find ways to make the most of it, and he's done a great job of that from an organizational standpoint, his preparation, his ability to lead his group.
quotes.social_post: J.B. Bickerstaff praised the development work of J.D. Dubois, noting his leadership and preparation have been key factors in the growth of the Pistons young players over the last two years.
